messages:
liz_devex: Kicking off a focused thread for Q2 SDK + quickstarts launch playbook. Need to align on must-haves vs nice-to-haves. @sophia_pm are we still aiming for the end-of-quarter launch window?
ajay_p: yes EoQ is the goal, but we need to scope to what we can ship without blocking other infra work.
sophia_pm: still EoQ. OKR tie: increase SDK-driven signups by 30% and reduce 'how to auth' tickets by 50%.
kevin_se: customer asks prioritizing async Python client, Node streaming SDK, and a React quickstart with server-side auth sample.
julie_support: +1 on auth: most tickets are about sessions & token rotation. If quickstart natively shows KMS + refresh flow, support load should drop.
liz_devex: Proposal: Phase 1 (MVP) = blocking features that hit OKR:
- core sync Python SDK + small async subset (auth patterns)
- Node SDK minimal streaming support (server->client)
- 3 quickstarts: chat-with-history, embeddings-search, react-auth-demo
- 1 sample app full CI + deployment guide
Phase 2 = nicer ergonomics, advanced batching helpers, additional language bindings.
ajay_p: sounds reasonable. What's the launch acceptance criteria?
sophia_pm: acceptance criteria draft:
- Docs: README + 3 quickstarts fully ops-tested
- SDKs: unit tests 80% coverage on core, integration tests passing against staging
- Samples: deployable to Vercel/GCP with <10min setup
- Security: token rotation + KMS example in at least one sample
- Performance: streaming latency <= 300ms p50 for small chat on Dedicated profile
- Support: runbook and troubleshooting doc for top 5 failure modes
kevin_se: add: backwards-compat note for existing beta SDK users and migration guide.
julie_support: add a 'common errors' FAQ and one pager for CS to hand to enterprise customers.
ci-bot: CI pipeline report: 2 failing integration tests in staging (auth refresh), flagged @kevin_se.
kevin_se: seeing that, will triage. If auth refresh blocks Phase 1, we can ship with a 'manual refresh' pattern but must clearly label it as temporary.
liz_devex: Let's negotiate scope: if auth refresh is a blocker, we drop Node streaming from Phase 1 and focus on Python + quickstarts. Node streaming moves to Phase 2. Thoughts?
ajay_p: acceptable tradeoff. Node streaming is higher engineering cost and fewer immediate customers.
sophia_pm: agree. Prioritize reducing support load and adoption metrics. Node streaming into Q3 OKR.
kevin_se: timeline check: auth refresh fix ETA 10 days, migration guide ETA 3 days. If we abort Node for Phase 1 we can still hit EoQ.
julie_support: I'll prepare CS one-pager and collect the top 12 auth questions to ensure quickstarts address them.
liz_devex: Launch checklist (short):
1) Docs + quickstarts published and tested
2) SDK pip/npm packages uploaded to staging registry
3) Integration tests green on staging
4) Sample app deployable with env var example and KMS note
5) Release notes + migration guide ready
6) CS one-pager and runbook uploaded to internal wiki
7) Postmortem plan for first-week rollouts

kevin_se: I'll send a PR with the auth patch and link test logs.
ajay_p: who owns release coordination? liz_devex?
liz_devex: I can own release coordination if product + eng agree on ship list. I'll run the cutover checklist and coordinate docs deploy.
sophia_pm: OKR tracking: add a metric for "time to first successful sample run" — aim < 15 minutes.
julie_support: also add "support tickets referencing quickstart" as a negative metric.
ci-bot: Reminder: schedule canary deploys and enable tracing on new SDK endpoints.
liz_devex: Action items: @kevin_se triage auth fix (10d), @julie_support compile FAQ (4d), @ajay_p confirm Q2 comms plan (5d), @liz_devex publish launch playbook and checklist (2d). Anyone want to add?
kevin_se: will update thread with PR link when ready.
ajay_p: I'll own comms and draft blog + changelog.
sophia_pm: locking scope: Phase 1 = Python sync+auth patterns, quickstarts (chat, embeddings, react-auth), sample app, docs + CS assets. Node streaming deferred.
liz_devex: Great. I'll create the GH milestone and add tickets. If anything urgent shifts, ping here and we'll re-prioritize. :thumbsup:
